source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the Town Clerk ruled the nomination of his only opponent, Robert Owens, out of order (Irish News, 8 January 1929)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation) together with the triennial election of aldermen for Clifton, Court, Cromac, Dock, Falls, Shankill, Victoria and Windsor; nominations 5 January, poll Tuesday 15 January 1929. Three aldermen and ten councillors were returned unopposed at nomination; after the withdrawals and the rejection of one nomination paper there were contests in six wards for four aldermanships and three councillorships (Belfast News-Letter, 7, 8 and 16 January 1929). Returned unopposed.
